notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
hello guys small cart to the end update. 
[list]
[*] there was a bug where sometimes the player's cart would despawn for no reason, this should now be fixed (hopefully)
[*] added back the inactive cart despawn so if the cart has been inactive for 120 seconds it would despawn by itself (should help with the performance of the game more by clearing inactive objects)
[*] also made it so the automatic shooters will only shoot if player is in the trigger (this will also help with game performance)
[*] made some small UI changes
[*] the game now has full controlller support + steam deck verified (this was from a previous update but I didn't release any patch notes about it)
[/list]

shoutout to anyone who still plays this, thank you. If you wanna help me out be sure to leave a review for the game if you haven't already or cop the amazing soundtrack ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
hello guys new cart to the end update lets go. 
I added a few new things which is very exciting

[b]New Cart Material[/b]
First thing I added was a new cart material for those that have beaten the game so you can show others that you have in fact beaten the game.

Wow look at how cool that is, it changes colour 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/I21L1MT.gif[/img]

[b]Leaderboard[/b]
I have also added a leaderboard. You can check out the top 50 in the game or you can go [url=https://steamcommunity.com//stats/3064990/leaderboards/14547095]here [/url]to look at all times.
 
Because there wasn't a leaderboard before you will unfortunately have to beat the game again for your time to submit, sorry about that. But look at the in game leaderboard, its so cool
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iJoaBA1.gif[/img]

[b]Text Chat[/b]
If you don't have a mic for some reason I have now also added a text chat so you can type gg 5 times.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Aq0VS1j.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes and minor UI changes[/b]
I also fixed a bug where sometimes your cart would just despawn when it hasn't been 60 seconds.
There is also some minor (calm down dr disrespect) UI changes nothing too crazy

As usual if you encounter any bugs or wanna give feedback, just make a discussion thread

[b]Soundtrack[/b]
Just also wanted to say the soundtrack is currently on sale if you want to buy ːsteamhappyː

That's all for now, ill add some more things in the future for this very alive game.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hello guys small update
[b][h1]New Things and Changes[/h1][/b]
I added a player list so when you hold TAB key in game, you can see player list. If your the host you can kick players so thats fun.

The cart now destroys after 60 seconds of inactivity instead of 90 seconds.

There is spawn protection meaning you can't shoot when you are at spawn, when you leave it, you can shoot. Will prevent some guy just spam shooting at the back.

[h1][b]Soundtrack[/b][/h1]
I also want to mention I recently released the Cart To The End Soundtrack, which is currently on sale. If you want to support me, you can purchase it + you get a very cool soundtrack so exciting.

There should be another update soon as well because im adding a few more things such as text chat, so exciting.
Thanks ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Bug fixes and changes
notes.content:
Hello guys here is new update for Cart To The End no way.
I have received a lot of feedback for this game and have made some changes to the game and fixed some bugs.

[h1][b]Some Changes[/b][/h1]
For the cart controls I have seen some people are bloody livid about how the cart rotation works, especially "Jeep", that guy got really mad but I understand why. Previously you can only rotate cart on the curved tracks but now you can rotate cart on any track which should help with your movement and will make it easier for you to constantly position yourself on the rail to decrease the chances of you derailing.
I have made it so if the cart is inactive for 90 seconds, it will automatically destroy.
Lift speed has been increased
You no longer have to hold the E/F key to enter/exit cart, you just press it.
Exiting cart now doesn't take 10 years, it will exit immediately.

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
Some synchronisation bugs regarding the lift has been fixed.
If you get launched into space to become Neil Armstrong you will actually respawn now, instead of waiting to fall back down. (Currently fixing the collider issue that is causing this, should hopefully be fixed by next update but for now its a temporary fix.)
I am also currently fixing another bug where the cart would shake like crazy, for now a temporary fix is to exit the cart then enter it again.

[b][h1]Upcoming[/h1][/b]
In the future, I will be adding 2 player carts where one player will be moving the cart and shooting and one player rotates the cart.
Will also be adjusting the third person camera because right now it is a bit shit but does the job for now. 
Adding a player list tab in game with kick/ban buttons for the host.

If you encounter any bugs or want to give me some feedback, please make a discussion thread in the community hub.

Thanks for playing, I appreciate it. ːsteamhappyː
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a7rnp8k.gif[/img]
